items.title: Universally parametrizing the open-and-closed subschemes of a quasi-finite map that are finite over the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a quasi-finite finitely presented morphism X -> Y of affine schemes, the lemma constructs a finite presentation morphism Y_univ -> Y and an open U_univ of Y_univ x_Y X which is finite over Y_univ, universally representing the functor that assigns to Y' -> Y the open subschemes U' of Y' x_Y X finite over Y': every such U' is the inverse image of U_univ for a unique-on-pixels Y' -> Y_univ. The retained proof is written: quasi-finite = relative dimension 0 (cited Morphisms lemma), Noetherian approximation reduces to X, Y Noetherian (chapter lemma Noetherian-approximation-dimension-d with d = 0); a quasi-finite scheme over Y embeds as an open of a Y-finite scheme X' (Algebra, lemma quasi-finite-open-integral-closure); an open of Y' x_Y X inside the finite Y'-scheme Y' x_Y X' is automatically also closed, so it corresponds to an idempotent of the base-changed algebra Gamma(Y',O) tensor Gamma(X',O); the finite case (chapter lemma open-and-closed-in-finite, previously collected) produces the universal pair (Y'_univ, e'_univ); the locus where U'_univ escapes Y'_univ x_Y X has closed image T, and removing T gives Y_univ with the required property. Retained author proof at lines 22847-22888.
